header.name: Galaxy Sun V01
header.description: The Sun and four planets (Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn) carried round the Milky Way's centre. The galactic sweep is sped up so 200 years shows as a 30-degree arc (the real pace is too slow to see); the planets keep their true orbits, tilted about 60 degrees to the galaxy. No orbit paths are drawn.
